nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Prompt)
widgets_values: A single continuous cinematic shot of one contemporary dancer wearing a flowing beige-gold dress, seated and kneeling on an old wooden floor in a spacious worn studio. Warm shafts of daylight fall from high windows through light haze. She arches her torso and gracefully sweeps her arms above her head and sideways, then bends toward the floor. Preserve the input scene, dress, body proportions, hand movements, composition and camera movement. Natural coherent skin, fingers, fabric folds and floor grain. No text, no additional people or objects.

nodes.title: 完整配方与使用方法
widgets_values:
在LoadVideo选择自己的视频，在CLIPTextEncode填写对应的原镜头提示词。默认1024×576输入，经学习型3D潜空间放大到2560×1440。来源窗口音轨独立送保存；原片无声音时使用静音。
完整加载节点读取作者合并Refiner+Turbo+Sharp线性LoRA和50个独立Sharp曲线分支。curve_source选择作者Ref2VA pruned表；两个强度均1，Turbo alpha已折入B。
默认Euler、BasicGuider（CFG1），3步sigma [.909375,6/7,2/3,0]；准备节点时钟1/1。原生网格124帧、交付121帧/24fps。静音经Audio VAE编码锁定，最终声音单独保存。
实际运行报告接采样后LATENT，计数为该MODEL准备以来累计。本机INT8底模/原生注意力/8分组与8FFN块。具体已验证范围、权重链接见docs/OPEN_REGENERATE_2K.md。
